items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: That’s Buddy Colette was on that session. We did that in Berlin.

ctx.x: Yeah. And you played contrabass clarinet on this?
Right. I’m doing that. That’s Buddy Colette was on that session. We did that in Berlin.
I’m curious when I listen to that, how much of the music was actually notated?
